A '''Kurtzen''' participated in an auction at [[Mawbo's Performance Hall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TG" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> The [[Kurtzen]] bid against the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Sligh]] for a [[Holocube/Legends|holocube]] that, the auctioneer claimed, showed an image of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at age nine. When a bidding war with the Squib ensued, the Kurtzen eventually relented.<ref name="TG" />
